name: Pack Tactics
description: While in a troop, or while an ally is within melee range of the same target, this creature's attacks gain +1 boon.

name: Formation Fighting
description: While an ally is within melee range of this creature, they gain +1 Parry.

name: Searing Form
description: A creature that touches this creature, or hits them with a melee attack from melee range, takes damage equal to the tier's secondary damage (ignore AV). Choose the damage type to match the creature.

name: Regeneration
description: At the start of each of their turns, this creature regains HP equal to their tier's weapon damage. This does not happen if they took damage of their named weakness since their last turn, and it does not work while they are in a place that denies it. Name both.

name: Sacrifice
description: When this creature would be hit by an attack, they can redirect it to target one ally within close range instead.

name: Guard Stance
description: This creature braces. Until the start of their next turn they gain +2 to one Defense, and they cannot use Movement.

name: Evasion
description: When this creature would take damage from an area attack, they roll Agility + Athletics vs. the attack's TN. On a success they take half damage. On a strong or critical success they take none.

name: Turn the Blow
description: When this creature is hit, they can reduce the success level of the attack by one step. They can use this ability once between their turns.

name: Untouchable
description: This creature is immune to physical damage. When they attack, or interact with a physical object or creature, they become only resistant to physical damage briefly.

name: Command
description: One allied creature within short range can immediately make an attack, or move up to close range.

name: Inspiring Presence
description: Allies within short range gain +1 boon on Morale checks and on saves against being frightened.

name: Escalating Grip
description: On a strong or critical hit with this creature's signature attack, the target is briefly stunned. If the target is already stunned, they are briefly paralyzed instead.

name: Elite Trigger — Broken Ground
description: When this creature loses their first life pool, the ground around them changes. Every area within short range becomes difficult terrain for the rest of the scene, and creatures entering or starting their turn there take the tier's secondary damage.

name: Elite Trigger — Second Wind
description: When this creature loses their first life pool, they immediately regain their recharging ability and use it.

name: Elite Trigger — Rally
description: When this creature loses their first life pool, every ally within medium range can immediately make a single attack, or move up to a short distance.

name: Lord Trigger — Shifting Ground
description: When this creature loses a life pool, choose one bounded option and state it before the fight: a persistent terrain change, a summoning that arrives after a stated delay, or an immediate area effect. A Lord needs two Lord Triggers, and each should change the tactical problem rather than raise a number.

name: Lord Trigger — The Oath Tightens
description: When this creature loses a life pool, their binding constrains them further and empowers them within it. For the rest of the scene they cannot willingly leave a stated area, and their attacks deal extra damage while they remain inside it.

name: Lumbering
description: This creature can either move or take an Action on their turn, not both. They cannot use Quick Actions.

name: Poor Sight
description: This creature suffers +1 bane on attack rolls against any target further away than short range.

name: Daylight Frailty
description: While in direct sunlight, this creature suffers +1 bane on all rolls.

name: Trample
description: When this creature moves through the space of a creature at least one size smaller, that creature rolls Agility + Athletics vs. this creature's ability TN or takes the tier's weapon damage and falls prone.

name: Night Vision
description: This creature can see one range category further from sources of bright and dim light.

name: Blindsense (close)
description: This creature perceives their surroundings at close range without relying on sight.

name: Flying
description: This creature can fly with 2 Movement per turn. While on the ground they can spend only 1 Movement in total during their turn.

name: Amphibious
description: This creature can breathe both air and water, and swims without penalty to their Movement.
